name: @krashidbuilt/actions
description: TypeScript-based reusable GitHub Actions for the krashidbuilt ecosystem

scripts.bundle: bun run build && bun run bundle:actions && bun run generate:actions
scripts.verify: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:coverage && bun run verify:bundles && bun run verify:bundles-fresh
scripts.verify:bundles-fresh: bun run bundle && git diff --exit-code actions/*/dist actions/*/*/dist || (echo '::error::Bundles are stale — run bun run bundle and commit' && exit 1)

author: Krashidbuilt <hello@krashidbuilt.com>
